scope: Generic item-aspect derivation for standard recipes and common material tags; no claim that every item of every mod has meaningful aspects.

original_methods.getObjectTags: Explicit/NBT/wildcard assignments first; otherwise generate recipe aspects; apply equipment, dye and enchantment bonuses.
original_methods.generateTagsFromRecipes: Crucible, then infusion, then crafting. Ordinary furnace recipes are not inspected.
original_methods.generateTagsFromCraftingRecipes: Select positive candidate with least total aspects; take first ingredient representative; subtract recipe remaining items; apply 75%/output count with original truncation.
original_methods.generateTags: Cycle/history guard; cache generated result; per-aspect cap500. getBonusTags then culls to seven aspect types.

compatibility_correction: Original TC6 supports many third-party items through OreDictionary material assignments, crafting ingredient recursion and item-class/enchantment bonuses. An unknown raw item with no recognized material, recipe route or explicit integration is not guaranteed aspects.
port_before: RecipeAspects already accepted any namespace for crafting/arcane/crucible recipes and AspectTags recognized c: common-material tags. It did not inspect modern workstation recipes.
changes: Prefer explicitly assigned valid material alternatives before deep recursive conversions; otherwise try recipe-derived representatives. Missing required tags reject uncraftable candidates. This avoids factorial recoloring graphs introduced after1.12.
Use cooking (smelting/blasting/smoking/campfire), stonecutting and smithing-transform as fallback only when no positive legacy crafting result exists; this preserves prior crafting-derived values.
Read smithing inputs via public recipe codec; no reflection or fabricated ingredients. Custom machine serializers and dynamic empty outputs still require explicit integration.

Modern cooking/stonecutting preserve material amount/output count without invented fuel or crafting loss; crafting/arcane/smithing retain75% arithmetic. Crafting-only remainder callbacks run only for crafting/arcane recipes.
Bound traversal to100active levels/4096visits and avoid caching any incomplete exhausted result. Ordinary cycles yield empty branches and do not cache intermediate results.
Isolate malformed third-party crafting callbacks and continue with alternate valid recipes. Synchronized per-calculator cache and deterministic manager recipe-ID order.
Recipe reload clears existing caches; root adding tag-update cache invalidation too.

Per-request memoization stores only subtrees that encounter no ancestor cycle. Narrow construction recipes precede broad conversion recipes; a route that hits an ancestor cycle cannot replace an already valid construction with eroded material aspects.

Construction ordering prioritizes shaped recipes before shapeless conversion routes, because broad planks tags otherwise make a real bed recipe look more complex than its recoloring loop. Acyclic alternatives still compete by the original smallest-positive-total rule.

tests.scope: Synthetic recipes against real loaded server registries. Uses already registered thaumcraft:research_icon as an otherwise unassigned non-vanilla output, without adding dummy gameplay items or asserting that an external content mod was installed.
checks: cycle with and without independent seed recipe
Loaded vanilla recipes for all64 colored wool/carpet/bed/shulker variants; exact white carpet/bed material contributions; mud brick slab and cracked deepslate tile processing retain Terra

limits: No universal inference for unknown raw materials or custom machine recipe formats.
Infusion recipe derivation cannot run until the corresponding gameplay recipe system exists in the port.
Alternative fallback and modern workstation support are deliberate 1.21.1 extensions, not claims about features present in TC6.
Automatic aspect derivation for newly supported workstations is deliberately adapted to modern processing; it is not a feature of originalTC6.
validation_note: Final shared release validation passed1990JUnit and56GameTests, including all64 colored-family material-route checks. The initial bed regression was fixed without weakening its material assertion.
